reviewer: Maipa independent browser acceptance review; no external reviewer claimed

Published Fancy notes appear with current release, dismiss and reopen via real pointer input.
Pointer-selected Dark has the approved computed canvas color and survives reload.
Focused published divider increases its announced value after a real ArrowRight key.
Narrow work panel is active, then pointer-selected Conversation reverses both inert states.

Foreign account404, missing-CSRF403 and owned real transport201/transport_verified/provider_ready:false; no provider CLI/login/model.

limits: Hashes preserve semantic review, not semantic correctness. Not a login UI, live conversation, full accessibility, worker isolation or Q05/Q06 release test. Each candidate requires its own final shared run.
additional_review: Physical dev/inode directory identity and native canonical paths replace brittle Windows string equality; fixed owned prefix and actual temporary parent remain required. A real alternate-casing test failed then passed, while foreign parent/unowned name remain refused. Fixed browser failure phases are public-safe metadata, all other diagnostics/paths/stdout/cookies discarded; two privacy/report tests observed red before implementation. Existing nine real app cases unchanged.
